source_refs.note: Exercise 9.1, Question 1 (book p. 268-269); answers on PDF 309 (Answers 9.1)

blocks.explanation:
Yeh principal value ka sawal hai. \(\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)\) ka matlab hai: woh angle jis ka sine \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) ho.
Lekin aise angles to bohat se hain, is liye hum sirf woh angle lete hain jo \(\sin^{-1}\) ki principal range \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein ho.
Plan bilkul Example 1 jaisa: expression ko \(y\) ke barabar rakhein, \(\sin y = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) likhein, aur range ke andar standard angle dhoondein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Isay \(y\) maan lein. Phir \(\sin y = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) hoga aur \(y\) range \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein hona chahiye. Standard angles (\(30^\circ, 45^\circ, 60^\circ\)) ki table yaad ho to jawab foran mil jata hai.

Sine wali equation banayein
\[\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = y\]
\[\sin y = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: Definition yeh hai ke \(y = \sin^{-1} x\) tab aur sirf tab jab \(x = \sin y\) ho, aur \(y\) principal range \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein ho. Yani inverse ko hata kar seedha sine ki equation likh li, jo humein zyada jaani pehchani lagti hai.

Standard angle pehchanein
\[\sin y = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \sin\frac{\pi}{3}\]
\[y = \frac{\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: Hum jaante hain ke \(\sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), aur radian mein \(60^\circ = \frac{\pi}{3}\). Yeh angle \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) ke andar hai, is liye yahi principal value hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) ka sine bhi \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) hai, lekin woh range se bahar hai; is liye woh principal value nahi ban sakta.

Tasdeeq
\[-\frac{\pi}{2} \le \frac{\pi}{3} \le \frac{\pi}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Do cheezein check karni hoti hain: angle range ke andar ho, aur us ka sine diya hua number ho. Dono sharten poori hain, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.explanation:
Humein \([0, \pi]\) ke andar woh angle chahiye jis ka cosine \(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\) ho.
Value negative hai. \([0, \pi]\) mein cosine sirf doosre quadrant (\(90^\circ\) se \(180^\circ\)) mein negative hota hai, is liye jawab wahin milega.
Plan: pehle reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) pehchanein (kyunke \(\cos\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\)), phir identity \(\cos(\pi - \theta) = -\cos\theta\) se minus sign wala angle banayein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Isay \(y\) maan kar \(\cos y = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\) likhenge, jahan \(y \in [0, \pi]\). Negative cosine ka matlab hai ke \(y\) doosre quadrant mein hai.

Cosine wali equation banayein
\[\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right) = y\]
\[\cos y = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(y = \cos^{-1} x\) ka matlab hai \(x = \cos y\) aur \(y \in [0, \pi]\). Inverse ko hata kar seedhi cosine ki equation likh li.

Reference angle se kaam lein
\[\cos\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\]
\[\cos\left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\]
\[\cos y = \cos\frac{3\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: Minus sign ko sambhalne ke liye identity \(\cos(\pi - \theta) = -\cos\theta\) lagayi. Yani \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ko \(\pi\) se minus karo to cosine ka sign ulta ho jata hai, value wohi rehti hai. \(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{3\pi}{4}\).
Dhyan dein: \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) jawab nahi hai. \(\cos(-\frac{\pi}{4})\) to positive hota hai, aur waise bhi \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) range \([0, \pi]\) se bahar hai.

Angle parh lein
\[y = \frac{3\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) range \([0, \pi]\) ke andar hai, is liye yahi principal value hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos\frac{3\pi}{4} = \cos 135^\circ = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(135^\circ\) doosre quadrant mein hai jahan cosine negative hota hai, aur reference angle \(45^\circ\) hai. Sab kuch mel kha raha hai.

blocks.explanation:
Humein \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) ke andar woh angle chahiye jis ka tangent \(-\sqrt{3}\) ho.
Is range mein tangent negative tab hota hai jab angle khud negative ho (chautha quadrant).
Plan: pehle yaad karein ke \(\tan\frac{\pi}{3} = \sqrt{3}\), phir odd function wali property \(\tan(-\theta) = -\tan\theta\) se minus sign andar le jayein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan^{-1}\left(-\sqrt{3}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Isay \(y\) maan kar \(\tan y = -\sqrt{3}\) likhenge, \(y \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\). Tangent odd function hai (yani \(\tan(-\theta) = -\tan\theta\)), is liye negative value ka angle bhi negative hoga.

Tangent wali equation banayein
\[\tan^{-1}\left(-\sqrt{3}\right) = y\]
\[\tan y = -\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: \(y = \tan^{-1} x\) ka matlab hai \(x = \tan y\), aur \(y\) principal range \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein ho.

Odd property lagayein
\[\tan\frac{\pi}{3} = \sqrt{3}\]
\[\tan y = -\tan\frac{\pi}{3} = \tan\left(-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)\]
\[y = -\frac{\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: \(\tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}\) standard value hai. Minus sign ko angle ke andar le gaye kyunke \(\tan(-\theta) = -\tan\theta\). \(-\frac{\pi}{3}\) range ke andar hai, is liye yahi jawab hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) ka tangent bhi \(-\sqrt{3}\) hai, lekin woh \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) se bahar hai. \(\tan^{-1}\) ka jawab kabhi \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) se bara nahi hota.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan(-60^\circ) = -\sqrt{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(-60^\circ\), \(-90^\circ\) aur \(90^\circ\) ke darmiyan hai aur us ka tangent \(-\sqrt{3}\) hai. Dono sharten poori.

blocks.explanation:
Humein woh angle chahiye jis ka secant \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\) ho aur jo \(\sec^{-1}\) ki principal range \(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cup \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\) mein ho.
Secant ke standard angles aam tor par yaad nahi hote, lekin cosine ke hote hain. Secant cosine ka ulta (reciprocal) hai, is liye hum sawal ko cosine mein badal denge.
Yeh wohi baat hai jo Example 4 mein saabit hui: \(\sec^{-1} x = \cos^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sec^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Isay \(y\) maan kar \(\sec y = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\) likhenge. Phir reciprocal le kar \(\cos y\) nikalenge, aur cosine ki standard value se angle pehchanenge.

Secant wali equation likhein
\[\sec^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right) = y\]
\[\sec y = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\]
Kyun: \(y = \sec^{-1} x\) ka matlab hai \(x = \sec y\), aur \(y\) principal range \(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cup \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\) mein ho.

Cosine mein badlein
\[\cos y = \frac{1}{\sec y} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\cos y\) aur \(\sec y\) ek doosre ke reciprocal hain. Fraction ka reciprocal lene ka matlab hai upar neeche palat dena: \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\) ulta ho kar \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) ban gaya.

Angle pehchanein
\[\cos y = \cos\frac{\pi}{6}\]
\[y = \frac{\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) aur \(30^\circ = \frac{\pi}{6}\). Yeh angle \(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein hai jo principal range ka hissa hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\sec^{-1}\) ki range mein \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) shamil nahi, kyunke wahan \(\cos = 0\) hai aur secant defined hi nahi hota.

Tasdeeq
\[\sec\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{\cos 30^\circ} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ka secant wapas wohi number deta hai jo sawal mein diya tha, aur angle range ke andar hai.

blocks.explanation:
Humein woh angle chahiye jis ka cosecant \(-\sqrt{2}\) ho, aur jo \(\csc^{-1}\) ki principal range \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right) \cup \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein ho.
Cosecant sine ka reciprocal hai, is liye sawal ko sine mein badal kar \(\sin y = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) solve karenge.
Is range mein sine negative tab hota hai jab angle negative ho, yani jawab \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right)\) wale hisse mein aayega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\csc^{-1}\left(-\sqrt{2}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Isay \(y\) maan kar \(\csc y = -\sqrt{2}\) likhenge, reciprocal se \(\sin y\) nikalenge, aur sine ki standard value se angle pehchanenge. Example 4 ka natija \(\csc^{-1} x = \sin^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\) yahi kehta hai.

Cosecant wali equation likhein
\[\csc^{-1}\left(-\sqrt{2}\right) = y\]
\[\csc y = -\sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: \(y = \csc^{-1} x\) ka matlab hai \(x = \csc y\), aur \(y\) principal range mein ho.

Sine mein badlein
\[\sin y = \frac{1}{\csc y} = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: \(\sin y\) aur \(\csc y\) reciprocal hain. \(-\sqrt{2}\) ka reciprocal \(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) hai; sign wohi rehta hai.

Angle pehchanein
\[\sin y = -\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \sin\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\]
\[y = -\frac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\). Sine odd function hai, \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\), is liye minus sign angle ke andar chala gaya. \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) range ke hisse \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right)\) mein hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{5\pi}{4}\) ya \(\frac{7\pi}{4}\) ka sine bhi \(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) hai, magar woh principal range se bahar hain.

Tasdeeq
\[\csc\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right) = \frac{1}{-1/\sqrt{2}} = -\sqrt{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ka cosecant wapas \(-\sqrt{2}\) deta hai, aur angle range mein hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh ek function ke andar doosra function hai, is liye andar se bahar ki taraf kaam karte hain, bilkul jaise brackets wale sawal mein pehle andar wala bracket hal karte hain.
Pehle \(\cos\frac{3\pi}{4}\) ka number nikalenge, phir us number ka \(\sin^{-1}\) principal range \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein dhoondenge.
Yaad rahe: sine aur cosine do alag functions hain, is liye yeh ek doosre ko cancel nahi karte.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin^{-1}\left[\cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)\right]\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Pehle andar wala cosine nikalenge, phir \(\sin y = \) us value ki equation bana kar \(y\) ko \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein dhoondenge.

Andar wala hissa nikalein
\[\cos\frac{3\pi}{4} = \cos\left(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\]
\[= -\cos\frac{\pi}{4} = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{3\pi}{4} = 135^\circ\) doosre quadrant mein hai jahan cosine negative hota hai. Identity \(\cos(\pi - \theta) = -\cos\theta\) se reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ki value minus ke saath mil gayi.

Inverse sine set karein
\[\sin^{-1}\left(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right) = y\]
\[\sin y = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\]
Kyun: Ab sawal sirf itna reh gaya ke kis angle ka sine \(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\) hai. Definition se \(y = \sin^{-1} x\) ka matlab \(x = \sin y\) hai.

Angle pehchanein
\[\sin y = \sin\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\]
\[y = -\frac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\), aur \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\). \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) principal range ke andar hai.
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students seedha \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) likh dete hain, yeh soch kar ke inverse aur function cancel ho gaye. Yeh ghalat hai: bahar \(\sin^{-1}\) hai aur andar \(\cos\), dono alag hain. Aur waise bhi \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) sine ki principal range se bahar hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right) = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} = \cos\frac{3\pi}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ka sine wohi number hai jo andar wale cosine se aaya tha, aur angle range mein hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi andar se bahar kaam karna hai: pehle \(\cot\frac{\pi}{6}\) ka number nikalein, phir us number ka \(\tan^{-1}\).
Jawab \(\tan^{-1}\) ki principal range \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein hona chahiye.
Cotangent ki value \(\cot\theta = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}\) se aasani se nikal aati hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan^{-1}\left[\cot\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\right]\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Pehle \(\cot\frac{\pi}{6}\) nikalenge, phir \(\tan y = \) us value ki equation se \(y\) ko \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein dhoondenge.

Andar wala hissa nikalein
\[\cot\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\cos 30^\circ}{\sin 30^\circ}\]
\[= \frac{\sqrt{3}/2}{1/2} = \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: \(\cot\theta = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}\). \(\cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) aur \(\sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\); dono ke neeche 2 hai jo cancel ho gaya.

Angle pehchanein
\[\tan^{-1}\sqrt{3} = y\]
\[\tan y = \sqrt{3} = \tan\frac{\pi}{3}\]
\[y = \frac{\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: \(\tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}\) standard value hai, aur \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) range \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) ke andar hai.
Dhyan dein: Jawab \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) nahi hai. Bahar \(\tan^{-1}\) hai aur andar \(\cot\); yeh ek doosre ko cancel nahi karte.

Tasdeeq
\[\frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: Complementary angles ki identity \(\cot\theta = \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right)\) kehti hai ke \(\cot\frac{\pi}{6} = \tan\frac{\pi}{3}\). Is liye jawab \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) bilkul wohi hai jo hona chahiye tha.

blocks.explanation:
Phir andar se bahar: pehle \(2\cos\frac{3\pi}{4}\) ka number, phir us ka \(\sec^{-1}\).
\(\sec^{-1}\) ke liye hum cosine mein badal dete hain, kyunke cosine ki values yaad hoti hain.
Jawab \(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cup \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\) mein hona chahiye; negative secant ka matlab hai jawab \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\) mein aayega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sec^{-1}\left[2\cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)\right]\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Andar ki value nikalenge, \(\sec y\) ko us ke barabar rakhenge, reciprocal se \(\cos y\) banayenge, aur principal range mein angle chunenge.

Andar wala hissa nikalein
\[2\cos\frac{3\pi}{4} = 2\left(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right) = -\sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: Part (vi) mein dekha tha ke \(\cos\frac{3\pi}{4} = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\). 2 se multiply kiya to 2 cancel ho gaya aur \(-\sqrt{2}\) bacha.

Cosine mein badlein
\[\sec^{-1}\left(-\sqrt{2}\right) = y\]
\[\sec y = -\sqrt{2}\]
\[\cos y = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: Definition se \(x = \sec y\), aur secant ka reciprocal cosine hai. Sign wohi rehta hai.

Angle pehchanein
\[\cos y = -\cos\frac{\pi}{4} = \cos\frac{3\pi}{4}\]
\[y = \frac{3\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\cos\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\), aur minus ke liye \(\cos(\pi - \theta) = -\cos\theta\). \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) range ke hisse \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\) mein hai.
Dhyan dein: Cosine negative hai to angle doosre quadrant mein hai; \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) jaisa negative angle \(\sec^{-1}\) ki range mein hota hi nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\sec\frac{3\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{-1/\sqrt{2}} = -\sqrt{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ka secant wapas andar wali value \(-\sqrt{2}\) deta hai.

blocks.explanation:
Andar ka hissa \(\sqrt{2}\cos\frac{\pi}{4}\) ek seedha sa number ban jata hai; phir us ka \(\csc^{-1}\) nikalna hai.
Cosecant ko sine mein badlenge, aur jawab \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right) \cup \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein hona chahiye.
Yahan range ka ek kinara (end point) jawab banega, is liye range ke brackets par dhyan dena zaroori hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\csc^{-1}\left(\sqrt{2}\cos\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Andar ki value nikalenge, \(\csc y\) ko us ke barabar rakhenge, aur \(\sin y = \frac{1}{\csc y}\) se angle pehchanenge.

Andar wala hissa nikalein
\[\sqrt{2}\cos\frac{\pi}{4} = \sqrt{2} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = 1\]
Kyun: \(\cos 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\). \(\sqrt{2}\) upar aur neeche cancel ho gaya, sirf 1 bacha.

Sine mein badlein
\[\csc^{-1}(1) = y\]
\[\csc y = 1 \Rightarrow \sin y = 1\]
Kyun: Definition se \(x = \csc y\); 1 ka reciprocal bhi 1 hai.

Angle pehchanein
\[\sin y = \sin\frac{\pi}{2}\]
\[y = \frac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 90^\circ = 1\). \(\csc^{-1}\) ki range \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par square bracket hai, yani yeh point shamil hai.
Dhyan dein: Range mein sirf \(0\) nikala gaya hai (kyunke \(\sin 0 = 0\) par cosecant defined nahi), \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\csc\frac{\pi}{2} = \frac{1}{\sin 90^\circ} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ka cosecant wapas andar wali value 1 deta hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan teen tah (layers) hain, jaise pyaz ke chhilke. Sab se andar wale bracket se shuru kar ke ek ek chhilka utarte jayenge.
Pehle \(\cos^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), phir 3 se multiply, phir cosine, phir dobara 3 se multiply, aur aakhir mein \(\tan^{-1}\).
Har qadam par sirf ek kaam karein, to ghalti ka chance khatam ho jata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan^{-1}\left[3\cos\left\{3\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)\right\}\right]\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Sab se andar wale bracket se bahar ki taraf, ek waqt mein ek layer hal karenge.

Sab se andar: inverse cosine
\[\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = \frac{\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) range \([0, \pi]\) mein hai, is liye yahi principal value hai.

Agla layer: curly bracket
\[3\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = 3 \cdot \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{2}\]
\[\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) ko 3 se multiply kiya to \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) bana, yani \(90^\circ\). Aur \(\cos 90^\circ = 0\).

Square bracket
\[3\cos\left\{\cdots\right\} = 3 \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Zero ko kisi bhi number se multiply karein, zero hi rehta hai.

Bahar wala layer
\[\tan^{-1}(0) = y \Rightarrow \tan y = 0\]
\[y = 0\]
Kyun: \(\tan 0 = 0\), aur \(0\) range \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) ke andar hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\tan \pi = 0\) bhi hai, lekin \(\pi\) range se bahar hai; principal value sirf \(0\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan 0 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har layer standard value thi aur aakhri angle principal range mein hai, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi layers wala sawal hai. Andar se shuru: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), phir us ka cosine, phir \(\frac{4}{3}\) se multiply, aur aakhir mein \(\csc^{-1}\).
Aakhri qadam mein cosecant ko sine mein badlenge, aur jawab \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, 0\right) \cup \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein hona chahiye.
Beech mein ek chhota sa simplification (radical ko saaf karna) bhi aayega; usay dhyan se dekhiye.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\csc^{-1}\left[\frac{4}{3}\cos\left\{\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)\right\}\right]\).
Maloom karna: is ki principal value.
Tareeqa: Sab se andar wale bracket se bahar ki taraf ek ek layer hal karenge.

Sab se andar: inverse tangent
\[\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) = \frac{\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) range \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein hai.

Cosine aur factor
\[\cos\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[\frac{4}{3} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{3} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{6}\) ko 2 se chhota kiya to \(\frac{2\sqrt{3}}{3}\) mila. Phir \(3 = \sqrt{3} \cdot \sqrt{3}\) likh kar ek \(\sqrt{3}\) cancel kiya to \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\) bana. Yeh shakal is liye behtar hai ke reciprocal lete hi \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) mil jata hai.

Bahar wala layer
\[\csc^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right) = y\]
\[\csc y = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \Rightarrow \sin y = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[y = \frac{\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: Cosecant ka reciprocal sine hai. \(\sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), aur \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) range ke hisse \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) ka sine bhi \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) hai magar woh \(\csc^{-1}\) ki range se bahar hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\csc\frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}/2} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ka cosecant wapas square bracket wali value deta hai, aur angle range mein hai.
